portfolio_v3.market_rationale: Cross-sectional spreads are large despite the missing aggregate dispersion statistic: semiconductor 21-session active return is +13.72%, versus -12.26% for mining. Narrow equity breadth, falling credit prices, rising dollar strength and restrictive policy argue against indiscriminate dip buying. Manufacturing and consumption remain firm enough to support selective reversals, but weak employment and elevated inflation leave substantial two-sided risk around October releases and the FOMC. Recent technology leadership lacks independent sector-specific fundamental confirmation in the briefing.
